messages.subject: CPD: 'Disclosure under the Disclosure Pilot - practical update' (lunchtime session)
messages.plaintextBody:
A reminder that our next CPD session, 'Disclosure - practical update', takes place on Thursday 5 March, 12:30-13:30 in the Bishopsgate training room (lunch provided). 1 CPD hour. Please register via the L&D portal. Spaces are limited.

L&D Team
